model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Soft classic watercolour storybook on cream paper; gentle washes, restrained vintage palette, calm composition, visible watercolour texture and soft edges; no text.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Bold overhead view of the exact girl, younger boy and small 4 kg Papillon Vanilla lying on a violet picnic blanket beneath an immense indigo-violet Milky Way and faint joined constellation; preserve cast identities, outfits, scale and soft classic watercolour style; correct hands, limbs and faces; no telescope, pointing, dusk hill, orange horizon or text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1 was previously accepted for anatomy and identity, then rejected by the owner because its standing hill, telescope, pointing pose and blue-orange dusk composition looked too similar to A Trip Through Space at thumbnail size.

images.name: stars-at-night
images.prompt: Same cast seated together on a cream blanket at true night as many stars become visible; telescope nearby; calm and safe; exact identities and scale; no text.

images.name: closest-star
images.prompt: One large dignified golden Sun, tiny Earth, and a small hill vignette of the cast and telescope, clearly teaching that the Sun is our closest star; no face or text.

images.name: far-away
images.prompt: Same cast seen mostly from behind using the telescope; one point star opens into a soft inset showing its enormous glowing sphere, explaining apparent size through distance; no text.

images.name: star-colours
images.prompt: Exactly three separate natural star spheres: blue-white and brightest, golden-yellow, and red-orange with a softer glow; scientifically clear object-only page; no text.

images.name: find-orion
images.prompt: Exact cast from behind finding Orion: four corner stars, three belt stars and short sword with faint guide lines; girl points with a complete five-digit hand; no text.
images.rejected: Attempt 1: REJECT — the raised pointing hand did not show an unambiguous five-finger structure.

images.name: why-stars-twinkle
images.prompt: A steady distant star sends light through soft moving air layers that bend the path before it reaches the hill telescope; small cast watches from behind; no text.

images.name: goodnight-stars
images.prompt: Late-night closing on the same hill: sleepy exact children under a cream quilt, tiny Vanilla asleep beside them, telescope angled down, calm stars above; hands tucked away; no text.
